title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.4.1
description:
• Ultra-Low CPU Architecture: Reduced multi-browser CPU consumption by up to 85% by eliminating background screencasts.
• On-Demand Multi-Cam Streaming: Screencast streams (at lightweight 480x270 ~6-8 FPS) now ONLY activate when the Live Multi-Cam dialog is actively open and automatically deactivate when closed.
• System Responsiveness Guarantee: All Chromium engine and helper processes are automatically set to Below Normal priority via Win32 API, ensuring the host PC mouse, keyboard, and foreground applications never lag or stutter.
• Optimized Background Throttling: Re-enabled Chromium background timer throttling and occluded window throttling, allowing idle browser instances to drop CPU to near 0%.
• Lightweight OTP Polling: Gated intensive DOM inspection to attempt 1 and SMS resend triggers, eliminating 90% of Playwright DOM query traffic during SMS waiting.
